description:
A robotics engineer is designing a drive shaft for a robot arm actuator. Create a cylindrical shaft with a keyway slot cut into it.

Specifications:
- Shaft: Cylindrical, 12 mm diameter, 80 mm long
- Keyway (rectangular slot cut into the shaft surface): 4 mm wide, 2.5 mm deep (measured from outer surface), 30 mm long
- The keyway runs parallel to the shaft axis, starts flush from one end, and is centered across the top of the shaft cross-section

Save the completed model to: ~/Documents/FreeCAD/drive_shaft_keyway.FCStd
